<details class="result-group" id="t2-2-tower-property">
<summary><span>T2.2 Tower Property</span><span class="result-count">2 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\mathbb{E}[\mathbb{E}[Y \mid \mathcal{G}_2] \mid \mathcal{G}_1] = \mathbb{E}[Y \mid \mathcal{G}_1]$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-tower-property">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.tower_property</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Theorem 2.2: tower property for nested sigma-algebras. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m₁ m₂ m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → Real},
  MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m₁ m₂ →
    ∀ (hm₂₀ : MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m₂ m₀) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm₂₀)],
      (MeasureTheory.ae μ).EventuallyEq (MeasureTheory.condExp m₁ μ (MeasureTheory.condExp m₂ μ Y))
        (MeasureTheory.condExp m₁ μ Y)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean#L26">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean:26</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-tower-property-x1-x2">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.tower_property_X1_X2</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Theorem 2.2 written as <code>E[E[Y | X₁, X₂] | X₁] = E[Y | X₁]</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β}
  {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → Real} {X1 : Ω → β} {X2 : Ω → γ} (hX1 : Measurable X1)
  (hX2 : Measurable X2) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.trim ⋯)],
  (MeasureTheory.ae μ).EventuallyEq
    (MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap X1 mβ) μ
      (MeasureTheory.condExp (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max (MeasurableSpace.comap X1 mβ) (MeasurableSpace.comap X2 mγ)) μ
        Y))
    (MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap X1 mβ) μ Y)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean#L37">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean:37</a></p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="result-group" id="t2-3-conditioning-theorem">
<summary><span>T2.3 Conditioning Theorem</span><span class="result-count">1 endpoint</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\int gY \, d\mu = \int g \, \mathbb{E}[Y \mid X] \, d\mu$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-conditioning-theorem-ae">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.conditioning_theorem_ae</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Theorem 2.3, a.e. version: pull out an <code>m</code>-measurable factor from conditional expectation. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {g Y : Ω → Real},
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω =&gt; instHMul.hMul (g ω) (Y ω)) μ →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable Y μ →
        (MeasureTheory.ae μ).EventuallyEq (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ fun ω =&gt; instHMul.hMul (g ω) (Y ω)) fun ω =&gt;
          instHMul.hMul (g ω) (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ Y ω)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean#L54">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean:54</a></p>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</details>

<details class="result-group" id="t2-5-finite-regression-error-variance">
<summary><span>T2.5 Finite Regression-error Variance</span><span class="result-count">1 endpoint</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\mathbb{E}[Y^2] \lt  \infty \Longrightarrow \mathbb{E}[e^2] \lt  \infty$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-memlp-ceferror">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.memLp_cefError</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.5: if <code>Y</code> has a finite second moment (<code>MemLp Y 2 μ</code>),
then the CEF error <code>e = Y - E[Y|m]</code> also has a finite second moment,
i.e., the regression-error variance σ² &lt; ∞. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → Real},
  MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp (HansenEconometrics.cefError μ Y m) 2 μ</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (1)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.cefError</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean#L26">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean:26</a></p>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</details>

<details class="result-group" id="t2-6-more-information-weakly-reduces-residual-variance">
<summary><span>T2.6 More Information Weakly Reduces Residual Variance</span><span class="result-count">1 endpoint</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\operatorname{Var}(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y \mid \mathcal{G}_2]) \le \operatorname{Var}(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y \mid \mathcal{G}_1])$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-variance-ceferror-antitone">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.variance_cefError_antitone</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.6:
monotonic decrease of residual variance under larger conditioning sets.
If <code>m₁ ≤ m₂ ≤ m₀</code>, then <code>Var[Y - E[Y|m₂]] ≤ Var[Y - E[Y|m₁]]</code>,
i.e., conditioning on more information (weakly) reduces
the variance of the regression error. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {m₁ m₂ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {Y : Ω → Real},
  MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m₁ m₂ →
    MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m₂ m₀ →
      ∀ [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
        MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ →
          Real.instLE.le (ProbabilityTheory.variance (HansenEconometrics.cefError μ Y m₂) μ)
            (ProbabilityTheory.variance (HansenEconometrics.cefError μ Y m₁) μ)</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (1)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.cefError</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean#L74">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean:74</a></p>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</details>

<details class="result-group" id="t2-7-conditional-expectation-as-best-predictor">
<summary><span>T2.7 Conditional Expectation as Best Predictor</span><span class="result-count">1 endpoint</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\mathbb{E}[(Y - g(X))^2] \ge \mathbb{E}[(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y \mid X])^2]$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-integral-sq-sub-condexp-le-integral-sq-sub">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.integral_sq_sub_condExp_le_integral_sq_sub</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.7 in sigma-algebra form: the conditional mean minimizes mean squared
prediction error among <code>m</code>-measurable square-integrable predictors. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y g : Ω → Real}
  (hm : MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m m₀) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
  MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp g 2 μ →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ →
        Real.instLE.le
          (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =&gt; instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub (Y ω) (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ Y ω)) 2)
          (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =&gt; instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub (Y ω) (g ω)) 2)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean#L175">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2CondExp.lean:175</a></p>
</div>
</details>

<details class="result-group" id="t2-8-law-of-total-variance">
<summary><span>T2.8 Law of Total Variance</span><span class="result-count">1 endpoint</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>$\operatorname{Var}(Y) = \mathbb{E}[\operatorname{Var}(Y \mid X)] + \operatorname{Var}(\mathbb{E}[Y \mid X])$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-law-total-variance">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.law_total_variance</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.8 / law of total variance in Mathlib form. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → Real},
  MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m m₀ →
    ∀ [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
      MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ →
        Eq
          (instHAdd.hAdd (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun x =&gt; ProbabilityTheory.condVar m Y μ x)
            (ProbabilityTheory.variance (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ Y) μ))
          (ProbabilityTheory.variance Y μ)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean#L33">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2Variance.lean:33</a></p>
</div>

<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta_minimizes_MSE</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Definition 2.5 / Theorem 2.9: the projection coefficient minimizes the population
linear-prediction mean squared error. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (QXX : Matrix k k Real) (QXY : k → Real) (QYY : Real)

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.9: population projection residuals are orthogonal to the regressors. </p></div>

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-linearprojectionbeta-minimizes-mse-of-moments">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta_minimizes_MSE_of_moments</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 2.9 in textbook moment notation: if <code>EXX = E[XXᵀ]</code>, <code>EXY = E[XY]</code>, and
<code>EY2 = E[Y²]</code>, then <code>β = (EXX)⁻¹ EXY</code> minimizes the population linear-prediction criterion. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (EXX : Matrix k k Real) (EXY : k → Real) (EY2 : Real)

    (∀ (v : k → Real), Real.instLE.le 0 (dotProduct v (EXX.mulVec v))) →
      ∀ (b : k → Real),
        Real.instLE.le
          (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE EXX EXY EY2 (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta EXX EXY))
          (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE EXX EXY EY2 b)</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (2)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE</code></li></ul></details>

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>At the projection coefficient, the quadratic criterion simplifies to <code>E[Y²] - β'QXY</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (QXX : Matrix k k Real) (QXY : k → Real) (QYY : Real)
  [inst_2 : Invertible QXX],
  Eq (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE QXX QXY QYY (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta QXX QXY))
    (instHSub.hSub QYY (dotProduct (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta QXX QXY) QXY))</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (2)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta</code></li><li><code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/Chapter2LinearProjection.lean#L51">HansenEconometrics/Chapter2LinearProjection.lean:51</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-linearprojectionbeta-eq-of-mse-eq">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta_eq_of_MSE_eq</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Under strict positive definiteness of the quadratic form, the projection coefficient is the
unique minimizer of the population linear-prediction criterion. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] (QXX : Matrix k k Real) (QXY : k → Real) (QYY : Real)
  (b : k → Real) [inst_2 : Invertible QXX],
  Eq QXX.transpose QXX →
    (∀ (v : k → Real), Ne v 0 → Real.instLT.lt 0 (dotProduct v (QXX.mulVec v))) →
      Eq (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE QXX QXY QYY b)
          (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionMSE QXX QXY QYY (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta QXX QXY)) →
        Eq b (HansenEconometrics.linearProjectionBeta QXX QXY)</code></pre>

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Chapter 2.12: the expected conditional variance equals the expected squared
CEF error. This is the regression-error variance identity following Definitions 2.1-2.2. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y : Ω → Real}

  MeasureTheory.Integrable (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub Y (MeasureTheory.condExp m μ Y)) 2) μ →
    Eq (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =&gt; ProbabilityTheory.condVar m Y μ ω)
      (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =&gt; instHPow.hPow (HansenEconometrics.cefError μ Y m ω) 2)</code></pre>

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-condexpl2-minimal">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.condExpL2_minimal</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Conditional expectation in <code>L²</code> is the orthogonal projection onto the space of
<code>m</code>-measurable square-integrable functions, hence it minimizes <code>L²</code> distance. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m m₀ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Y g : Ω → Real}
  (hm : MeasurableSpace.instLE.le m m₀) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hY : MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ)
  (hg : MeasureTheory.MemLp g 2 μ),
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ →
    Real.instLE.le
      (MeasureTheory.Lp.instNorm.norm
        (instHSub.hSub (MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp Y hY)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (MeasureTheory.condExpL2 Real Real hm) (MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp Y hY)).val))
      (MeasureTheory.Lp.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp Y hY) (MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp g hg)))</code></pre>
</details>
